How to Make Plov

Ingredients

  • 500 g rice
  • 500 g beef or lamb
  • 3 carrots, cut into strips
  • 2 onions
  • Cumin, salt and oil

Steps

  1. Heat the oil in a heavy pot and brown the meat.
  2. Add the onions, then the carrots, and fry until soft.
  3. Add water, cumin and salt and simmer for 30 minutes.
  4. Spread the washed rice on top without stirring and add water to cover.
  5. Cover and cook on low heat until the rice is done, then mix and serve.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is semantic HTML?

Using tags that describe the meaning of the content, not only how it looks.

When should I use <main>?

For the main content of the page. Use it only once per page.

What is the difference between <section> and <article>?

An article makes sense on its own; a section is a themed part of something bigger.

Why use <nav>?

It marks the main navigation links so assistive technology can find them.

Performance Optimization Homework

Student: Muhammadmuso Fatkhullaev (202637351)

Optimizations Applied (3 items):

  • 1. Lazy Loading Images: Added loading="lazy" to all below-the-fold images to prevent unnecessary initial network traffic.
  • 2. Deferring Scripts: Added the defer attribute to JavaScript files so scripts download asynchronously without blocking HTML parsing.
  • 3. Resource Preloading: Added for critical stylesheets to speed up the critical rendering path.

Lighthouse Score Comparison

Before Optimization

78

After Optimization

100

Description: By implementing lazy loading for images, deferring non-critical scripts, and preloading stylesheets, the page load performance score improved significantly from 78 to 100 on Lighthouse.
